notes:
• Card types. When you add a card, choose Credit card, Debit card or Prepaid card. A credit card shows what you owe and, if you add its limit, how much you can still spend. A prepaid card keeps its own balance.

• Debit cards belong to a bank account. Pick the account and the card shows that account's balance and entries. It is not counted twice in your net worth.

• Dual currency cards. Turn on Dual currency for a credit or prepaid card to keep a separate dollar side, with your own dollar rate. When you add an entry on that card, switch between Taka and Dollar. Budgets and reports use the taka value, and you can change it if your bank charged a different amount.

• Insurance companies now show their logos in the insurer list and on your policies. More banks, finance companies and government lenders have logos too.

• Rapid Pass is now its own account type, next to Other.

• New bottom tabs: Home, Wealth, Add, Budget, Activity.

• On Home, the Expense, Income, Transfer and Lend buttons now sit under your income, spent and saved figures. A new button next to the eye saves your folder backup right away.

• On Wealth, Add account is now a button under your accounts.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on this version cannot be restored on an older version.

iPhone (test build): FinUtopia-0.2.25-ios-unsigned.ipa installs with Sideloadly (sideloadly.io) or AltStore and your Apple ID, on iOS 15 or newer. With a free Apple ID, install it again every 7 days. Your data stays. The folder backup is Android only.
